diff --git a/mm/shmem.c b/mm/shmem.c
index e2c76a30802b..2027ae8d812a 100644
--- a/mm/shmem.c
+++ b/mm/shmem.c
@@ -4032,6 +4032,14 @@ static int shmem_unlink(struct inode *dir, struct dentry *dentry)
 	if (inode->i_nlink > 1 && !S_ISDIR(inode->i_mode))
 		shmem_free_inode(inode->i_sb, 0);
 
+    /*
+     * If the inode is already unlinked, we simply return success/ENOENT.
+     * This avoids crash in drop_nlink if multiple threads race to unlink
+     * (e.g. overlayfs setup vs cleanup).
+     */
+    if (!inode->i_nlink)
+        return -ENOENT;
+
 	simple_offset_remove(shmem_get_offset_ctx(dir), dentry);
 
 	dir->i_size -= BOGO_DIRENT_SIZE;
